thread:
maria_cs: Weekly spend check for BlueHarbor hosted account — commit $15k/mo. This week burn = $6.8k and we got an anomaly flag: +140% day-over-day yesterday. Looks streaming-heavy. Anyone have immediate context?

sam_engine: I see the spike in infra telemetry — streaming session rate x5 between 03:12-04:00 UTC. Suspect debug/verbose_stream left on in their client. Query: https://dash.redwood.com/alerts/7892 — shows per-session counts.

ian_billing: Quick numbers from billing view — remaining committed coverage ~$9.2k. If this continues at current rate we'll exhaust commit mid-month and go to overage. Recommend temp cap until root cause found.

alert-bot: ANOMALY ALERT: BlueHarbor (hosted) — spend +142% vs baseline. severity: medium. Link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/evt/2123456789

jess_onboarding: BlueHarbor PM pinged me — they rolled out an opt-in analytics stream yesterday to our API for an experiment. I'm asking them to pause that path now.

oliver_analytics: I can add a dimensioned breakdown by client_id + region and push a quick dashboard. ETA ~20m. Meanwhile two recommended actions: 1) temporary rate cap, 2) add token burn alert at 50% daily rate.

sam_engine: Ops applied a token cap for BlueHarbor: `POST /internal/admin/accounts/blueharbor/caps {"daily_token_cap":120000}` — pushing a small routing change to reject `verbose_stream=true` on the ingress path. Monitoring for errors.

maria_cs: Thanks. Please also ping the customer with a short notification (cc @jess_onboarding) confirming we paused the high-volume stream and applied a temporary cap. Offer a spend review and options (rate limits, dedicated capacity).

jess_onboarding: Draft msg I'm sending: "We've paused the experimental streaming path and applied a temporary usage cap while we investigate. We'll follow up with a usage breakdown and recommended mitigations (rate limiting, batching, or Dedicated capacity)." Sending now.

ian_billing: I'll open a billing ticket to flag potential invoice hold if burn remains >70% of commit for 3 consecutive days. Ticket: #BILL-4421.

oliver_analytics: Dashboard patch deployed. New board: https://dash.redwood.com/boards/blueharbor-spend — added client_id split. Sharing snapshot in 10m.

sam_engine: Rolling metrics show token rate dropping after cap — still watching 1hr window. No error spike from the reject rule so far.

maria_cs: TL;DR: temporary caps applied, customer notified, analytics breakdown added, billing ticket opened. Schedule 30m sync tomorrow to review commit vs usage and propose options. :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Closing thread after sync unless something new pops up.
